title: No rewinding and sharing to tv is a problem
body: There seems to be a problem when sharing the screen to the tv and the inability to rewind or backtrack during a yoga workout is absolutely absurd. Will be stopping my subscription soon.
author: piccvb

title: Crashes.
body: I like to share on my tv because of i don’t  looking at my phone while working out. (Too small) Today it crashed 3 times during my workout. One time it restarted from the beginning. Third time I just gave up and cancelled my subscription. Too bad. I really liked it.
author: Nancygt

title: Horrible UX
body:
Similar to the Health app, everything is a mess. It’s so hard to use, not intuitive at all. 

Where are the useful filters? I don’t care who the instructor is,  I care about the body area we’re targeting, whether it’s suitable for beginners, intermediate, or advanced, what are the benefits? Will it help my pain? What equipment do I need? You should really consider benchmarking other fitness apps.
